# HaploTraitR

![HaploTraitR logo](icon/logo_2.png)

**From GWAS hits to breeding decisions.**  
Haplotype-based trait analysis for plant breeders, in one R function
call.

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.2.0-4575B4?style=flat-square)![R](https://img.shields.io/badge/R-%E2%89%A5%204.1-276DC3?style=flat-square&logo=r&logoColor=white)![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-1A9850?style=flat-square)![Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-3-7B61C9?style=flat-square)![No
compiler
needed](https://img.shields.io/badge/compiler-not%20needed-E8702A?style=flat-square)![ICARDA](https://img.shields.io/badge/developed%20at-ICARDA-2C6E7F?style=flat-square)

## ✨ Why HaploTraitR?

GWAS points to single SNPs. Breeders select on **haplotypes**, the
combinations of alleles inherited together. HaploTraitR bridges the two
and answers the questions a breeder asks next:

[TABLE]

## 🔎 How it works

![HaploTraitR workflow](reference/figures/haplotraitr_workflow.png)

## 📦 Installation

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("AlsammanAlsamman/HaploTraitR")
```

> \[!TIP\] HaploTraitR uses only **ggplot2**, **openxlsx** and **cli**
> (which comes with ggplot2). It has no compiled code, so it installs on
> Windows, macOS and Linux without Rtools or a compiler.

## 🚀 Quick start

``` r

library(HaploTraitR)

results <- run_haplotraitr(
  gwas      = "my_gwas_results.csv",   # marker, chromosome, position, p-value
  genotypes = "my_genotypes.hmp.txt",  # HapMap (.hmp.txt) or VCF (.vcf / .vcf.gz)
  pheno     = "my_phenotypes.tsv",     # first column = accession, then one column per trait
  trait     = "Yield",
  unit      = "t/ha",
  outfolder = "results_yield",
  higher_is_better = TRUE              # FALSE for e.g. disease scores or days to heading
)
```

**Try it now** with the barley example data that ships with the package:

``` r

ex <- function(f) system.file("extdata", f, package = "HaploTraitR")

results <- run_haplotraitr(
  gwas = ex("gwas_area_ann19.csv.gz"), genotypes = ex("Barley_50K.tsv.gz"),
  pheno = ex("area_ann19.tsv"), trait = "Area", unit = "cm2",
  outfolder = "barley_example", config = list(fdr_threshold = 0.1)
)
```

The console guides you through every step and ends with a colour-coded
summary:

![Console output](reference/figures/example_console.png)

**My GWAS file uses other column names**

  

Tell HaploTraitR which columns to use:

``` r

run_haplotraitr(..., config = list(rsid_col = "Marker", chr_col = "Chr",
                                   pos_col = "Pos", pval_col = "P.value"))
```

**I have several traits**

  

Call
[`run_haplotraitr()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/run_haplotraitr.md)
once per trait, each with its own GWAS file and output folder:

``` r

for (trait in c("Yield", "Height", "Heading")) {
  run_haplotraitr(gwas = paste0("gwas_", trait, ".csv"), genotypes = "panel.hmp.txt",
                  pheno = "traits.tsv", trait = trait, outfolder = paste0("results_", trait),
                  higher_is_better = trait != "Heading")
}
```

## 📊 What you get

Everything is written to your output folder. **Start with the Excel
report.**

|  | Output | What it shows |
|:--:|----|----|
| 📗 | `HaploTraitR_<trait>.xlsx` | Formatted report with superior haplotypes highlighted, see the sheets below |
| 🗺️ | `plots/genome_overview` | Manhattan plot with the haplotype blocks highlighted |
| 📈 | `plots/haplotype_effects_summary` | Effect of every haplotype in every block (% vs population mean) |
| 🌱 | `plots/candidate_accessions` | Top accessions and the superior haplotypes they carry |
| 🧬 | `plots/haplotype_blocks/` | Per block: haplotype alleles, trait mean ± 95% CI and the LD heat map |
| 🎻 | `plots/haplotype_trait_plots/` | Per block: trait distribution of each haplotype with letter groups |
| 🔬 | `plots/gwas_snp_plots/` | Per GWAS SNP: trait distribution of each genotype |
| 🗂️ | `tables/`, `LD_matrices/`, `parameters.txt` | CSV copies of all tables, LD matrices and the settings used |

**Excel report sheets**

  

| Sheet | Content |
|----|----|
| **Read me** | What each sheet contains and how to interpret it |
| **Block summary** | One row per block: superior haplotype, effect, evidence and a **recommendation** |
| **Haplotype effects** | Accessions, frequency, mean, 95% CI, difference vs population and **letter groups** |
| **Haplotype alleles** | The allele of each haplotype at each SNP |
| **Diagnostic markers** | SNPs that tag the superior haplotype; *fully diagnostic* ones are KASP candidates |
| **Candidate accessions** | The haplotype every accession carries, ranked by superior haplotypes carried |
| **Pairwise tests** · **GWAS SNPs** · **Parameters** | Full statistics, the GWAS SNPs used and the settings |

## 📖 How to read the results

| Term | Meaning |
|----|----|
| **H1, H2, …** | Allele combinations carried by at least `comb_freq_threshold` (10%) of the accessions; H1 is the most frequent |
| **Other** | Rare combinations, plus accessions with too many missing calls |
| **Letter groups** | Haplotypes sharing a letter do not differ significantly; **a** is the best group |
| **Evidence: Strong** | The superior haplotype is significantly better than *every* other haplotype |
| **Evidence: Moderate** | It is significantly better than *some* of the others |
| **Evidence: None** | No significant difference: low priority for selection |

> \[!NOTE\] If **Other** is the best group, the favourable variant is a
> rare haplotype. Lower `comb_freq_threshold` (for example `0.05`) to
> separate it.

## ⚙️ Settings

**All settings** (see them in R with `list_config()`)

  

Change settings with
[`set_config()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/set_config.md)
or with the `config` argument of
[`run_haplotraitr()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/run_haplotraitr.md).

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|----|----|----|
| `fdr_threshold` | 0.05 | FDR threshold used to select significant GWAS SNPs |
| `dist_threshold` | 1000000 | Window (bp) around each GWAS SNP |
| `dist_cluster_count` | 5 | Minimum number of SNPs in a window / block |
| `ld_threshold` | 0.3 | Minimum LD (r²) to link SNPs into a block |
| `comb_freq_threshold` | 0.1 | Minimum frequency of a haplotype |
| `hap_max_missing` | 0.2 | Maximum fraction of missing calls when assigning an accession to a haplotype |
| `t_test_method` | `"t.test"` | `"t.test"` (Welch) or `"wilcox.test"` |
| `p_adjust_method` | `"holm"` | Correction for pairwise haplotype tests |
| `t_test_threshold` | 0.05 | Significance level |
| `higher_is_better` | `TRUE` | Direction of the favourable trait value |
| `plot_format` / `plot_dpi` | `"png"` / 300 | Plot file format and resolution |

**Step-by-step workflow** (for advanced users)

  

Every step of
[`run_haplotraitr()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/run_haplotraitr.md)
is available on its own:

``` r

library(HaploTraitR)
set_config(list(phenotypename = "Area", phenotypeunit = "cm2", fdr_threshold = 0.1,
                outfolder = create_unique_result_folder(location = "sampleout")))
ex <- function(f) system.file("extdata", f, package = "HaploTraitR")

gwas      <- read_gwas_file(ex("gwas_area_ann19.csv.gz"))
hapmap    <- readHapmap(ex("Barley_50K.tsv.gz"))            # or readVCF("file.vcf.gz")
pheno     <- read.delim(ex("area_ann19.tsv"))

gwas_sig  <- filter_gwas_data(gwas)                          # significant GWAS SNPs
windows   <- getDistClusters(gwas_sig, hapmap)               # SNPs near each GWAS SNP
LDsInfo   <- computeLDclusters(hapmap, windows)              # LD (r2) matrices
blocks    <- getLDclusters(LDsInfo)                          # LD blocks
haps      <- convertLDclusters2Haps(hapmap, blocks)          # haplotypes per block
haps      <- getHapCombSamples(haps, hapmap)                 # accessions per haplotype
acc       <- getSNPcombTables(haps, pheno)                   # accession x haplotype x trait
tests     <- testSNPcombs(acc)                               # pairwise haplotype tests
summary   <- summarize_haplotypes(haps, acc, tests)          # effects, superior haplotypes
markers   <- diagnostic_markers(haps, summary)               # markers for MAS
ranking   <- rank_accessions(haps, pheno, summary)           # candidate parents

plot_haplotype_block("2H:582673984", haps, summary)          # one block (by block id or GWAS SNP)
plotHapCombBoxPlot("2H:582673984", acc, tests)               # trait by haplotype
plot_effect_summary(summary)
plot_candidate_accessions(ranking, summary)
plot_haplotypes_genome(gwas, haps, summary = summary)
```

**Method notes**

  

- **LD** is the squared correlation (r²) between allele dosages, the
  standard unphased r².
- **Blocks:** SNPs within `dist_threshold` of a GWAS SNP are linked when
  r² ≥ `ld_threshold`. The connected group that contains the GWAS SNP is
  its block. GWAS SNPs that share a block are analysed once.
- **Haplotypes** are allele combinations above `comb_freq_threshold`. An
  accession with a few missing calls (up to `hap_max_missing`) is
  assigned to the single haplotype that matches its observed alleles.
- **Tests:** Welch ANOVA (or Kruskal–Wallis) per block, then pairwise
  Welch t-tests (or Wilcoxon tests) with `p_adjust_method` correction.
  Letter groups use the insert-and-absorb algorithm.
- The workflow diagram is drawn with JavaScript in
  `tools/flowchart/flowchart.html`. Regenerate the PNG with
  `tools/flowchart/render.sh`.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`barley_area`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/barley_area.md)
  : Barley leaf area example data
- [`boxplot_genotype_phenotype()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/boxplot_genotype_phenotype.md)
  : Generate boxplots of the trait for each significant GWAS SNP
- [`computeLDclusters()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/computeLDclusters.md)
  : Compute LD matrices for the distance clusters
- [`convertGenoBi2Numeric()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/convertGenoBi2Numeric.md)
  : Convert HapMap genotypes to allele dosages
- [`convertLDclusters2Haps()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/convertLDclusters2Haps.md)
  : Convert LD clusters to haplotypes
- [`create_unique_result_folder()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/create_unique_result_folder.md)
  : Create a unique result folder for HaploTraitR
- [`diagnostic_markers()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/diagnostic_markers.md)
  : Find diagnostic SNPs for the superior haplotypes
- [`extract_hapmap()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/extract_hapmap.md)
  : Extract HapMap data for significant SNPs
- [`filter_gwas_data()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/filter_gwas_data.md)
  : Filter GWAS data by FDR threshold
- [`find_nearby_snps()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/find_nearby_snps.md)
  : Find nearby SNPs to a given SNP list assuming they are in the same
  chromosome
- [`generateHapCombBoxPlots()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/generateHapCombBoxPlots.md)
  : Generate and save the haplotype trait plots of all blocks
- [`getDistClusters()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/getDistClusters.md)
  : Get distance clusters around the significant GWAS SNPs
- [`getHapCombSamples()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/getHapCombSamples.md)
  : Assign accessions to haplotypes
- [`getLDclusters()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/getLDclusters.md)
  : Cluster SNPs based on LD matrices
- [`getSNPcombTables()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/getSNPcombTables.md)
  : Build the accession-level haplotype and phenotype table
- [`get_config()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/get_config.md)
  : Get a configuration parameter
- [`get_pheno_geno()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/get_pheno_geno.md)
  : Get the phenotype and genotype data
- [`list_config()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/list_config.md)
  : List all the configuration parameters
- [`load_config()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/load_config.md)
  : Load configuration from a file
- [`plotCombMatrix()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/plotCombMatrix.md)
  : Plot the haplotype allele matrix of a block
- [`plotHapCombBoxPlot()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/plotHapCombBoxPlot.md)
  : Plot the trait distribution of each haplotype
- [`plotLDCombMatrix()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/plotLDCombMatrix.md)
  : Plot LD and haplotype matrices of all blocks
- [`plotLDForClusters()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/plotLDForClusters.md)
  : Plot LD heat maps for all LD blocks
- [`plotLDheatmap()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/plotLDheatmap.md)
  : Plot an LD heat map
- [`plot_candidate_accessions()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/plot_candidate_accessions.md)
  : Plot the best candidate accessions
- [`plot_effect_summary()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/plot_effect_summary.md)
  : Plot the haplotype effects of all blocks
- [`plot_haplotype_block()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/plot_haplotype_block.md)
  : Plot a haplotype block: alleles, trait effects and LD
- [`plot_haplotypes_genome()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/plot_haplotypes_genome.md)
  : Plot the haplotype blocks across the genome
- [`prepare_pheno()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/prepare_pheno.md)
  : Prepare phenotype data
- [`rank_accessions()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/rank_accessions.md)
  : Rank accessions by the superior haplotypes they carry
- [`readHapmap()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/readHapmap.md)
  : Read a HapMap genotype file
- [`readVCF()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/readVCF.md)
  : Read a VCF file into HapMap format
- [`read_gwas_file()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/read_gwas_file.md)
  : Read GWAS results file with specified columns
- [`reset_config()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/reset_config.md)
  : Reset the configuration to default
- [`retrieveLDMatricesFromFolder()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/retrieveLDMatricesFromFolder.md)
  : Get LD matrix information from a folder
- [`run_haplotraitr()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/run_haplotraitr.md)
  : Run the complete HaploTraitR analysis
- [`saveTTestResultsToFile()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/saveTTestResultsToFile.md)
  : Save the haplotype test results to a file
- [`save_config()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/save_config.md)
  : Save configuration to a file
- [`set_config()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/set_config.md)
  : Set configuration parameters for HaploTraitR
- [`summarize_haplotypes()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/summarize_haplotypes.md)
  : Summarise haplotype effects for breeders
- [`testSNPcombs()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/testSNPcombs.md)
  : Test trait differences between haplotypes
- [`write_excel_report()`](https://alsammanalsamman.github.io/HaploTraitR/reference/write_excel_report.md)
  : Write the HaploTraitR results to a formatted Excel workbook
